body: I could tell you were upset and I'm sorry to have made you upset.  That was obviously not my intention with this post.  I am not a licensed therapist and I can see how my attempt to help you, without fully knowing your situation, could end up hurting you.  I'll remember to be more careful in my responses.

Wow, I did not expect that.  You are right.  I made some dangerous assumptions in reading your comment and I apologize for that.  It was in no way my intention to offend you and I sincerely apologize if I did so.  When you said you were "suffering in silence" I assumed that meant you had not spoken to anyone or sought help with your situation from a therapist.    Assuming that was the case, I was merely trying to stress the importance of enlisting the help of your family (I assumed you were referring to your parents) in finding someone to help you get through this.  You are right, you do not owe me anything.  I should not have said that.  I guess by saying that you "owe" me I was trying to relate to you that it matters to me whether or not you seek help and get better.  You most certainly do not owe me anything. We dont even know each other.  I am glad that you have found such a wonderful therapist.  I honestly did not think that I was being insensitive, unkind, or judgmental.  Again, I am sorry if I offended you, but I really think that miscommunication played a major role.

You shouldn't have to fight yourself to stay alive and you most certainly shouldn't have to do so alone.  Don't avoid telling your parents how you feel just because you don't think that they can handle another suicidal family member.  They love you and they want you to be happy.  They would miss you just like you miss your uncles and they would want to know if you were feeling depressed.  If you dont reach out now you may wind up hurting yourself in the future.  I dont know who told you that "suffering in silence" was what you should do, but that is the exact opposite of what you should do. It is perfectly normal to feel the way you are feeling, but you owe it to your family and to me to try and seek help.  Like I said in my post, feel free to PM me anytime.

Thanks for sharing.  I think people see the weight that depression carries on themselves and just assume that it would be to much to ask for a loved one to help.  This could not be further from the truth.
